title: LRMoE：面向显存受限节点的MoE高效训练需求侧负载重校准
summary: LRMoE是一种内存感知的MoE训练系统，通过联合重校准反向传播需求并平衡保留负载，在前向阶段规划保留配额与专家放置，在反向阶段用负载重校准指标筛选token-专家对并做容量感知路由与物理压缩，从而降低通信、计算与执行缓冲需求。在Qwen3-30B-A3B和GLM4.5-106B-A12B上，达到固定损失目标的累计MoE层训练时间较SYMI减少21.2%-44.8%。
summary_en: LRMoE is a memory-aware MoE training system that jointly recalibrates backward demand and balances retained workload. It plans retention quotas and expert placement during forward, then uses a load recalibration metric to select token-expert pairs during backpropagation, with capacity-aware routing and physical compaction to cut communication, computation, and buffer demand. On Qwen3-30B-A3B and GLM4.5-106B-A12B, it reduces cumulative MoE-layer training time to fixed-loss targets by 21.2-44.8% versus SYMI.
